title: Recurrent neural chemical reaction networks that approximate arbitrary dynamics
abstract: A molecular version of a recurrent artificial neural network built from coupled CRNs. Proves universal approximation of arbitrary dynamics with enough chemical neurons and fast reactions, and demonstrates multistability, oscillations, and chaos. Experimentally implementable with DNA strand displacement.

title: Chemical reservoir computation in a self-organizing reaction network
abstract: Formose reaction network in a CSTR performs nonlinear classification, Boolean logic, XOR, and Lorenz attractor forecasting. Uses mass-spectrometry readout and demonstrates proof-of-concept chemical readout.

title: Supervised learning in DNA neural networks
abstract: Extends DNA-based winner-take-all networks to supervised learning by optimizing DNA gate concentrations. Demonstrates molecular pattern recognition.

title: Heat-rechargeable computation in DNA logic circuits and neural networks

title: A recursive enzymatic competition network capable of multitask molecular information processing

title: Noise-robust chemical reaction networks training artificial neural networks
